mapper.sql: select id, recpt_no, recpt_type, source_type, source_id, source_no, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, status, recpt_date, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wm_recpt
mapper.insert: insert into wm_recpt (recpt_no, recpt_type, source_type, source_id, source_no, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, status, recpt_date, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{recptNo}, #{recptType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{status}, #{recptDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update wm_recpt set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{recptId}
mapper.insert: insert into wm_recpt_item (recpt_id, item_id2, item_code, item_name, batch_code, quantity, unit, remark) values (#{recptId}, #{itemId2}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{batchCode}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{remark})
